title: Craftable Enchanted Golden Apples by Hexafoxx
description: Craftable Enchanted Golden Apples is a plugin that re-adds crafting enchanted golden apples, bringing back the OG. Minecraft, but making it a tiny bit easier.
body:
This plugin brings back the ability to craft Enchanted Golden Apples, restoring a classic feature that many players loved. Instead of being limited to rare loot, players can now create these powerful items themselves using a balanced and challenging recipe.

To craft an Enchanted Golden Apple, surround a regular Golden Apple with 4 Gold Blocks in the crafting grid. This keeps the recipe expensive while still making it achievable in survival gameplay.

Perfect for survival servers, SMPs, and PvP environments, this plugin adds more progression, strategy, and excitement by giving players control over one of the game's most iconic items.
